expect_red: sweep: interpolation is exact at both endpoints, and the midpoint of a 90-degree rotation is 45 degrees

mutations.contract: A scrubbed frame between two solved points interpolates translation linearly and rotation by slerp. Half way between two poses 90 degrees apart is 45 degrees, not whatever a component-wise blend of two rotation vectors gives.
mutations.note: The mutation is the one every implementation starts as: lerp the rotation VECTORS and skip the quaternions. It is exact at both endpoints -- which is why an endpoints-only test passes it -- and wrong everywhere in between, by more the further apart the poses are.
